label: Rusher
win_condition: Effective pressure: pace, volume discipline, ring cutting, bodywork, corner pressure, momentum, and forced mistakes.
risk_condition: Inaccuracy, repetition, poor spacing, overcommitment, wasted stamina, and failure to reset.
counterplay: lateral movement and pivots off the cut angle
body work to tax the pace
clinch and reset against a spent burst
readable_signals: posture forward of the lead foot
